Class HighScoreTable

java.lang.Object
backend.model.HighScoreTable
public class HighScoreTable extends Object
Stores and maintains the global high score leaderboard.

This class keeps leaderboard entries sorted in descending score order, limits the table to 10 records, and provides the core operations used to qualify, insert, reset, and inspect leaderboard data.

Design Documentation Section 5.2; FR 3.9.3.

Team 49 - CS2212B Winter 2026

  • Constructor Details

    • HighScoreTable

      public HighScoreTable()
      Creates an empty leaderboard table.

      This constructor is also used by Gson during deserialization before the entry list is populated from persisted data.

  • Method Details

    • addEntry

      public boolean addEntry(HighScoreEntry entry)
      Attempts to add a new entry to the leaderboard. The entry is inserted only if it qualifies (see qualifies(int)). After insertion the list is re-sorted and trimmed to 10.
      Parameters:
      entry - the new entry to consider
      Returns:
      true if the entry was added; false if the entry was null or did not qualify

    • qualifies

      public boolean qualifies(int score)
      Checks cheaply whether a given score would make it onto the leaderboard, without constructing a full HighScoreEntry.
      Parameters:
      score - the score to test
      Returns:
      true if the score would be added to the table; false otherwise

    • reset

      public void reset(List<HighScoreEntry> defaults)
      Resets the leaderboard to a list of default placeholder entries. Called by the Parent/Teacher "Clear Global High Scores" action (FR 3.7).
      Parameters:
      defaults - ordered list of default entries to install after clearing

    • resetToEmpty

      public void resetToEmpty()
      Resets the leaderboard to empty (no default placeholders).
